It is a request that looked at the distant future.
Android and other functional restrictions are put in, but avatar upload from other than PC · Unity (mainly from android and standalone VR)
I think that API for developer for service creation similar to that will be needed.
For me,  only support input from VRM or FBX,(If you use Generic avatar, OBJ may be valid as well.)
Shader adopted only Standard or MTOON.
I think that it is the limit to assign shape keys and hand movements to various hand signs.

A quasi-personal computer OS such as android does not have a means of uploading the current avatar.
Even if you have a fee-based model that you obtained with legitimate means, you may not be able to use it.

It is most preferable that the Unity editor for android (with VRC compatible version included) comes out, but since you can not see the signs to appear so far, if you hear a voice saying you want to upload from other than PC possibilities you may have to think in the future there is.

Since the avatar model of VRC etc. has its own format which depends on Unity, if we do not make some sort of work
From now on, I think that it may be an obstacle when services such as uploading avatar for VRC are generated after automatically generating.

* VRM, model based on gltf 2 for Japanese VR
* MTOON, Toon shader that is standardized by  VRM
title: From android and Standalone VR equipment, APIs for uploading avatars and uploading avatars and worlds from outside VRC service are prepared.
